title: Skuru Game Plan
summary: Skuru beat DISK 95–47 on 13 September. They started fast (24–6 in Q1) and their four main scorers produced 91 of their 95 points.
source: One-game sample: Skuru Basket 95–47 DISK, 13 Sep 2026

players.name: #2 Tage Johansson
players.note: Primary scoring threat. Locate him early in transition and take away clean perimeter catches; he also did major damage inside the arc.

players.name: #8 Simon Stenkvist
players.note: High-volume perimeter danger. Stay attached off the ball and make every catch uncomfortable — no easy rhythm threes.

players.name: #12 Frederic Dahl
players.note: Interior finisher. Meet him early with a body, wall up at the rim, and avoid reaching after he gets deep position.

plan: Be ready from tip-off: Skuru led 24–6 after Q1 and 47–20 at half in this report.
Call out #2 and #8 in transition. Together they made nine threes and scored 59 points.
Make their supporting cast create: the top four scorers accounted for 91 of 95 points in this game.
This is a one-game sample, not a complete scouting report — adjust quickly to the line-up and what is happening on court.
